妮娜的最爱(Nina's Favorite Things): 围绕节日文化的A1短文:介绍妮娜的日常、喜好与月光小院。
After school, we play together. The spring market is big and clean. I am happy every day. Please sit next to me on the bus.
Nina usually eats fish for lunch. I like my life very much. The moon-lit yard is not far from my home. For example, may I borrow your dictionary?
Nina and David are in the same class. We talk about math a lot. Nina wants to visit Rome.
